title: 强化学习实现广泛且持久的良性模型对齐
summary: 研究通过强化学习在真实领域训练良性行为（如诚实、公平、风险意识），发现该方法能在超过80%的分布外基准上提升对齐表现，并展现出跨领域迁移和对对抗性攻击的持久抵抗力。
summary_en: Study shows RL training on beneficial behaviors (truthfulness, fairness, risk awareness) in realistic domains improves alignment on over 80% of out-of-distribution benchmarks, with cross-domain transfer and persistence against adversarial attacks.
